about: Source table of the catalogue section `substances` (engine/CHEM.md, Data files): species outside the aqueous network, and records that add catalogue data to a network solid (`overlay`: the id is a solid of aqueous.json). Read by scripts/chem/build_catalog.py, which computes `comp` and `M` from `formula`, converts the solubility points from degrees Celsius to kelvin, fills `rho`, `Tm` and `Tb` of an element (`el`) from src/chem/data/elements.json, takes Hf, S and cp of a record that names a `nasa` species from the NASA Glenn polynomials shipped with Cantera, and moves `f`, `name`, `color` and `texture` into the section `display`. Units: Hf, Hfus, Hvap, Hsol kJ/mol; S, cp J/(mol K); rho g/cm3 (near 20 C); Tm, Tb, Tign K; antoine [A, B, C, Tmin, Tmax] with log10(p/bar) = A - B/(T/K + C); sol [[t/C, g of the anhydrous compound per 100 g of water], ...]. A value that is absent is unknown (written as null in the product), never a guess.

sources.CODATA: J. D. Cox, D. D. Wagman, V. A. Medvedev: CODATA Key Values for Thermodynamics, Hemisphere, New York 1989
sources.NBS: D. D. Wagman et al.: The NBS Tables of Chemical Thermodynamic Properties, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 11, Suppl. 2 (1982)
sources.CRC: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 97th ed. (2016): Standard Thermodynamic Properties of Chemical Substances; Physical Constants of Inorganic / Organic Compounds; Enthalpy of Fusion; Enthalpy of Vaporization; Flammability of Chemical Substances
sources.SOL: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 97th ed. (2016): Aqueous Solubility of Inorganic Compounds at Various Temperatures, in the usual form g per 100 g of water; for the salts of the school curriculum the same numbers as the solubility table in the appendix of the Chinese secondary-school chemistry textbooks (PEP)
sources.NIST: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69: Antoine equation parameters (bar, K)
sources.TB: Chinese secondary-school chemistry textbook (PEP): the value used in class

defaults.src: the thermodynamic values Hf, S, cp of a record: `nasa` given -> NASA (entry file); otherwise the source named by `src` (entry hand)
defaults.propSrc: rho, Tm, Tb, Hfus, Hvap, Tign typed by hand from CRC unless the record has `el` (then rho, Tm, Tb from elements.json) or names another source in `propSrc`
